details.purpose: Evaluating quality of life in patients with colorectal cancer.
details.keywords: screening, quality of life, cancer, depression, mood, assessment, mental health, QOL, QLQ, EORTC, QLQ-CR29, CR29
details.use:
Use to record the results of the quality of life of colorectal cancer patients (QLQ-CR29) using the European Organization for the Research and Treatment of Cancer questionnaires (EORTC). It should always be complemented by the QLQ-C30.
While openEHR archetypes are all freely available under an open license, the specific content of this archetype is copyright protected. Any use of this archetype within implementations must be in compliance with the terms established by the copyright owners. Copyright statement: © Copyright 1995 EORTC Quality of Life Group.
